name: rec_synth_bench
description: rec_synth_bench is a synthetic recommendation benchmark providing generated user-item interaction data to evaluate recommender algorithms. It is intended to let researchers test ranking and rating-prediction methods in controlled settings and to probe behavior under known distributions and sparsity patterns. The synthetic nature makes it useful for ablation studies and stress tests of recommender models.
reputation: A niche synthetic benchmark useful for algorithmic experiments and debugging; modest adoption relative to large real-world recommendation datasets.
